lessons.title: Separate ordinary CI work from heavy performance evidence
source_evidence: GitHub Actions run 36963016026: ordinary unit verification executed full representative/stress/scaling workloads and ran for roughly 39 minutes before cancellation
lessons.rule: When performance heavy validation is selected, explicitly bound the maximum representative/scaling work ordinary CI may execute and separately name the full workload owned by engineering-validation. Full representative, stress, or scaling workloads must not silently migrate into ordinary unit/E2E verification.
lessons.do_not_generalize_to: Do not prohibit bounded representative correctness smoke tests, structural fixture checks, or full workloads whose correctness genuinely requires the full horizon and whose CI ownership has been explicitly approved.
lessons.promotion_reason: The failure consumed substantial CI time and exposed an ambiguity in the handoff/verification ownership contract; the rule is narrow, deterministic, and preventive.
lessons.counterevidence: Repeated tasks may show that a specific bounded workload is cheap and correctness-critical enough for ordinary CI; that is handled by an explicit task boundary, not by weakening this lesson.
lessons.review_criteria: Retire as codified when the base handoff and verification contracts plus self-tests make omission impossible without relying on the lesson entry.

lessons.title: Prefer application-owned injection seams over shared platform fault injection
source_evidence: PR #32 E2E diagnostic-clock test replaced global browser performance.now and timed out
lessons.rule: When an application-owned diagnostic/test seam exists, inject failures through that seam instead of corrupting shared browser/runtime primitives used by frameworks or schedulers.
lessons.do_not_generalize_to: Do not ban platform-level fault injection when the platform boundary itself is the subject under test and the test environment isolates it safely.
lessons.counterevidence: A later isolated platform-boundary test may be correct and should not be rejected merely because this candidate exists.
lessons.review_criteria: Promote only after recurrence or when a specific profile contract can express the boundary deterministically.

lessons.title: Keep hook runtime features within declared environment compatibility
source_evidence: PFM push policy raised 'str' object has no attribute 'removeprefix' during PR #32 publication
lessons.rule: Agent-control code should use language/runtime features guaranteed by the declared hook environment, with self-tests for publication-critical paths.
lessons.do_not_generalize_to: Do not freeze application/runtime language features to the hook interpreter's compatibility floor.
lessons.counterevidence: If the hook interpreter becomes explicitly version-pinned and verified, newer features within that pin are acceptable.
lessons.review_criteria: Promote if another compatibility failure occurs or the framework adopts an explicit Python version contract.
